title: Store rclone tokens outside the repository
context: Document and enforce where rclone credentials live, how they are protected, and how they are rotated.

spec.summary: Store rclone tokens outside the repository
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The backup archive excludes rclone configuration.
A secret scan checks for token-shaped strings in tracked files.
A lost-token recovery path is documented.
The runbook names the owner of each remote.
